issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Panorra needs a Trail post: one post made of 1..n GoThru tours (hosted F1 or Google G1), where each tour is a key point with a name and a height, plus difficulty, activity and route metrics. Today an embed post holds a single URL in posts.panorama, and the trail UI in the PWA (detail, fullscreen, create) runs on mock data.

Source spec: "Update New Panorra 360 Layout" (1 Oct 2026), plus PM answers of 2 Oct 2026.

Goal

Backend support for creating, editing, reading and listing trail posts, built on the existing embed flow (POST /posts/init then POST /posts/complete-embed) instead of a new post pipeline.

Decisions (2 Oct 2026)

  • Stored as post_type = 'trail'; the PWA sends is_post=trail. The category is always Trail (id 8) and is set by the backend, not chosen by the user.
  • Difficulty: easy, medium, hard, expert. Activity: hiking, trail-running, mountain-biking, walking, off-road.
  • Route metrics are computed by the PWA. The backend sanity-checks and stores them.
  • Height is typed by the user and 0 is valid. No estimated duration for now. No cap on the number of points.
  • Embed URLs may be tourmkr.com/F1… or tourmkr.com/G1…; one prefix per post.
  • A tour must be published and owned by the user. This is verified against APIL (apil.gothru.co). APIW is no longer used.
  • A trail can be edited after publish, including its points.

Child Tasks

Ten tasks, about 11 working days for one engineer. Start with BE-01, BE-02, BE-04 and BE-07: none of them has a dependency.

Task Issue Repo Estimate (days) Depends on
BE-01 API contract and collection examples #579 both 0.5 –
BE-02 Migration and Trail category GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new#530 api-new 0.5 –
BE-04 Parse and validate trail GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new#531 api-new 1 –
BE-05 Save trail in /posts/complete-embed GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new#532 api-new 1.5 BE-02, BE-04
BE-06 Verify tour ownership and publish status via APIL GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new#533 api-new 2 BE-05
BE-07 Clean up GET /gothru/virtual-tours #580 api-go 1 –
BE-10 trail object in detail and draft detail #581 api-go 1.5 BE-02
BE-11 Handler tests with a stubbed APIL #583 both 1 BE-05, BE-06, BE-07, BE-10, BE-12, BE-13
BE-12 GET /posts/trails for the Trail menu #582 api-go 1 BE-02
BE-13 Edit trail after publish GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new#534 api-new 1 BE-05, BE-06

The task ids follow the PRD. BE-03, BE-08 and BE-09 were dropped: route metrics are computed by the PWA, height is typed by the user, and the Trails / Tours tabs are gone.

Acceptance Criteria

  • A trail post can be saved as draft, published, edited after publish and deleted through panorra-api-new.
  • Saving rejects tours that are not the user's own or are not published.
  • GET /posts/detail and GET /posts/draft-detail/:sid return a trail object; posts that are not trails return trail: null.
  • GET /posts/trails lists public trail posts for the Trail menu.
  • Existing embed post types (tourmkr, gvt, villume, video) behave exactly as before.

PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md in panorra-api-go.

issues.display_title: Issue #579: Trail Post: API Contract and Collection Examples
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-01 API Contract & Bruno Collection Examples

Summary

Documented the complete request/response contracts for all Trail Post endpoints across both read (panorra-api-go) and write (panorra-api-go-new) services using Bruno OpenCollection (.yml) format, fulfilling Epic #578 and Issue #579.

Files Created & Updated

panorra-api-go (api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Trail/)

  • folder.yml (seq: 19, display name "Trail")
  • Post Detail - Trail.yml (GET /posts/detail?slug=... with full trail object and points)
  • Post Detail - Non Trail.yml (GET /posts/detail?slug=... with trail: null)
  • Draft Detail - Trail.yml (GET /posts/draft-detail/:sid?type=trail)
  • List Trails.yml (GET /posts/trails?page=1&limit=10)
  • Virtual Tours - Cleaned.yml (GET /gothru/virtual-tours with filter query params and thumbnail)

panorra-api-go-new (api-collection/Panorra API Post/Trail/)

  • folder.yml (seq: 13, display name "Trail")
  • Save Trail Draft.yml (POST /posts/complete-embed with is_post=trail, action=draft)
  • Publish Trail.yml (POST /posts/complete-embed with is_post=trail, action=publish)
  • Edit Trail.yml (POST /posts/edit-trail with published trail sid)
  • Delete Trail Draft.yml (DELETE /posts/delete-draft/:sid?type=trail)

Frontend Integration Guide & Contracts

1. Data Models (TypeScript)

export type TrailDifficulty = 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard' | 'expert';

export type TrailActivityType =
  | 'hiking'
  | 'trail-running'
  | 'mountain-biking'
  | 'walking'
  | 'off-road';

export interface TrailPoint {
  url: string;           // 'https://tourmkr.com/F1...' or 'G1...'
  name: string;          // Required on publish, max 100 chars
  height_m: number;      // User input, default 0, max 2 decimal places
  lat: number;           // Overwritten by APIL on backend
  lng: number;           // Overwritten by APIL on backend
  distance_km: number;   // Cumulative: first is 0, last equals total_distance_km
  thumbnail?: string;    // Tour thumbnail URL
}

export interface TrailPayload {
  difficulty?: TrailDifficulty;     // Required on publish
  activity_type?: TrailActivityType; // Required on publish
  total_distance_km?: number;       // Required on publish, >= 0
  elevation_gain_m?: number;        // Required on publish, >= 0
  elevation_loss_m?: number;        // Required on publish, >= 0
  elevation_min_m?: number;         // Required on publish, must equal min(height_m)
  elevation_max_m?: number;         // Required on publish, must equal max(height_m)
  points: TrailPoint[];             // Min 1 point, ordered by route sequence
}

Epic: #578 (trail-post)
PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md, task BE-01
Estimate: 0.5 day

Problem

The PWA trail screens (detail, fullscreen, create) run on MOCK_TRAIL_DATA. The front end needs the request and response shapes before the handlers exist, so it can switch off the mock in parallel with backend work.

Scope

Documentation only, no handler code. Add or update the api-collection entries, with request and response examples, in both repos:

  • panorra-api-new: POST /posts/complete-embed with is_post=trail (draft and publish), POST /posts/edit-trail, DELETE /posts/delete-draft/:sid?type=trail.
  • panorra-api-go: GET /posts/detail and GET /posts/draft-detail/:sid with the trail object, GET /posts/trails, and the cleaned-up GET /gothru/virtual-tours.

Field names of the trail metrics match TrailMetrics in the PWA's trail.model.ts (total_distance_km, elevation_gain_m, elevation_loss_m, elevation_min_m, elevation_max_m), without estimated_duration_mins. Difficulty is easy, medium, hard, expert.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Every endpoint above has one success example and the error examples listed in the PRD.
  • Examples for trail and non-trail posts both exist for detail (trail object vs trail: null).

issues.display_title: Issue #580: Trail Post: Clean Up GET /gothru/virtual-tours Response
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-07 Clean Up GET /gothru/virtual-tours & Overlay Active Filter + Thumbnail

Summary

Refactored GET /gothru/virtual-tours to clean provider internal fields, drop inactive tours by default, add support for custom overlay filters (goverlay_active, foverlay_active), and include the new thumbnail response field per Epic #578, Issue #580, and the latest specifications.

Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go:
    • Added Thumbnail string to struct CleanVirtualTour (json:"thumbnail").
  2. src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru.go:
    • Stripped UTF-8 BOM (0xEF 0xBB 0xBF) from raw provider responses before json.Unmarshal.
    • Updated FetchVirtualTours signature to support forwarding foverlay_active and goverlay_active query params to upstream GoThru APIL.
  3. src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTours.go:
    • Unlinked user handling: returns HTTP 200 with data: [] and linked: false (was HTTP 404).
    • Added query param extraction & validation:
      • goverlay_active / Goverlay_active (valid: 0, 1, 2, 3, comma-separated).
      • foverlay_active / Foverlay_active (valid: 0, 1, 2, 3, comma-separated).
      • Invalid values return standard 400 Bad Request.
    • Forwarding overlay filters to APIL provider.
    • Enhanced filterAndTransformTours:
      • When filters provided: matches tours against requested overlay status.
      • When no filter provided: drops tours where both overlays are inactive (neither 1 nor 3).
      • Maps thumbnail field (with fallbacks thumb, tour_thumb, tour_thumbnail).
    • Standardized errors using Functions.ErrorResponse.
    • Added 60s Redis caching with composite cache key including overlay filter values.
  4. src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTours_test.go:
    • Added 10 unit test cases covering unlinked user, filtering, BOM stripping, provider errors, overlay filters, and thumbnail mapping.

Frontend Integration Guide

Endpoint

GET /gothru/virtual-tours

Headers

Header Value Description
Authorization Bearer <JWT_TOKEN> Required
Accept application/json Required

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
search string No "" Search by tour_name or tour_key. Pass {tour_key} to verify a pasted link.
page integer No 1 Page number (min: 1)
per_page integer No 20 Items per page (min: 1, max: 100)
foverlay_active string No - Comma-separated list of active states for hosted tours. Valid: 0,1,2,3. E.g. 1,3
goverlay_active string No - Comma-separated list of active states for Google tours. Valid: 0,1,2,3. E.g. 0,2

Response Model (TypeScript)

export interface VirtualTourItem {
  tour_key: string;       // E.g. "PWHsBHrg"
  name: string;           // E.g. "Spirit Mountain Recreation Area"
  lat: number;            // E.g. 46.717
  lng: number;            // E.g. -92.2151
  cid: string;            // Google CID (from 1_cid)
  hosted_active: boolean; // True if foverlay_active is 1 or 3
  google_active: boolean; // True if goverlay_active is 1 or 3
  thumbnail: string;      // Tour cover/thumbnail URL
  created_at: string;     // ISO timestamp string
}

export interface VirtualToursResponse {
  statusCode: 200;
  linked: boolean;
  data: VirtualTourItem[];
  pagination: {
    total: number;
    page: number;
    per_page: number;
    total_pages: number;
  };
}

Example Usage

Example 1: Fetch Published Tours for Trail Picker

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/gothru/virtual-tours?page=1&per_page=20&foverlay_active=1,3&goverlay_active=1,3" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>"

Response (HTTP 200 OK)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "linked": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "tour_key": "PWHsBHrg",
      "name": "Spirit Mountain Trailhead",
      "lat": 46.717,
      "lng": -92.2151,
      "cid": "3464457016628092545",
      "hosted_active": true,
      "google_active": false,
      "thumbnail": "https://img.panorra.com/tours/PWHsBHrg/thumb.jpg",
      "created_at": "2026-02-19T20:19:07Z"
    },
    {
      "tour_key": "G8kL9mNp",
      "name": "Lookout Point",
      "lat": 46.721,
      "lng": -92.2185,
      "cid": "8920192837461928374",
      "hosted_active": false,
      "google_active": true,
      "thumbnail": "https://img.panorra.com/tours/G8kL9mNp/thumb.jpg",
      "created_at": "2026-03-01T11:20:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 2,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total_pages": 1
  }
}

Example 2: Verifying a Pasted Link

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/gothru/virtual-tours?search=PWHsBHrg" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>"

Example 3: User with No GoThru Account Linked

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "linked": false,
  "data": [],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 0,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total_pages": 0
  }
}

Example 4: Invalid Parameter Error

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/gothru/virtual-tours?foverlay_active=5" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>"

Response (HTTP 400 Bad Request)

{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "data": {
    "status": "Bad Request",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Invalid foverlay_active value",
      "input": "foverlay_active"
    }
  }
}

Epic: #578 (trail-post)
PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md, task BE-07
Estimate: 1 day

Problem

GET /gothru/virtual-tours (shipped 1 Oct 2026, #577) works, but does not match what the trail picker needs:

  • A user with no user_keycloak_link row gets 404; the spec wants an empty state.
  • Every provider column is passed through, including internal ones (stats_key, api_key_id, share_key).
  • Unpublished tours are included; a trail may only use published tours.
  • A provider response with data: null is passed on as null.

The change of response shape was agreed on 2 Oct 2026. The PWA does not call this endpoint yet.

Scope

  • No Keycloak link: 200 with data: [] and linked: false (instead of 404). Linked users get linked: true.
  • data is always an array.
  • Return only these fields per tour: tour_key, name (from tour_name), lat, lng (as numbers), cid (from 1_cid), hosted_active, google_active, created_at.
  • hosted_active / google_active come from foverlay_active / goverlay_active; values 1 and 3 count as active. Tours with neither active are dropped.
  • Cache per user and query for 60 seconds.
  • Strip a leading UTF-8 BOM before json.Unmarshal. Successful responses of two public APIL endpoints start with EF BB BF; test this endpoint with a real service token.
  • Errors through Functions.ErrorResponse, like the rest of the repo.
  • Update the api-collection example and the existing tests.

Notes

  • Upstream is APIL: GET /internal/users/{keycloak_sub}/virtual-tours in GoThru-API-New. Its search matches tour_name or tour_key, so ?search={tour_key} is also how the PWA checks a pasted link (it replaces the APIW call).
  • APIL already creates the GoThru user for an unknown keycloak_sub, so no provisioning is needed here.
  • Dropping unpublished tours happens after APIL has paginated, so pagination.total still counts them. An overlay filter in APIL would fix that; it is on the request list in the PRD.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Unlinked user: 200, data: [], linked: false.
  • No internal provider field reaches the client.
  • A tour with both overlays inactive is not returned.
  • A provider response starting with a BOM is decoded.

issues.display_title: Issue #581: Trail Post: Add trail Object to Post Detail and Draft Detail
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-10 Trail Object in Post Detail & Draft Detail

Summary

Added the trail object to GET /posts/detail and GET /posts/draft-detail/:sid endpoints to support the Trail Detail, Fullscreen Route, Elevation Profile, and Point Carousel in the PWA, fulfilling Epic #578 and Issue #581.

Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Models/PostsModel.go:
    • Defined TrailDetail and TrailPointDetail structs.
    • Added Trail interface{} json:"trail" gorm:"-" to V1DetailPost and DetailDraft models.
  2. src/Action/V1/Posts/TrailLoader.go:
    • Implemented LoadTrailForPost(postId string, postType string) interface{}.
    • Queries post_trails and post_trail_points by post ID (ordered by sequence ASC).
    • Returns nil for non-trail posts or missing records.
    • Made injectable with LoadTrailForPost function variable and nil-DB safe for tests.
  3. src/Action/V1/Posts/DetailPost.go:
    • Resolved post ID and invoked LoadTrailForPost for published & self-processing posts.
    • Added "trail" to allowedFields and switch mapping for include parameter filtering.
  4. src/Action/V1/Posts/DetailDraftPost.go:
    • Resolved post ID from sid and loaded trail object for draft posts when post_type == 'trail'.

Frontend Integration Guide

1. Endpoints

  • Published Post Detail: GET /posts/detail?slug={slug}
  • Draft Post Detail: GET /posts/draft-detail/{sid}?type=trail

2. Response Types (TypeScript)

export interface TrailPointDetail {
  sequence: number;    // 1..n (route order)
  name: string;        // E.g. "Trailhead / Start Point"
  url: string;         // E.g. "https://tourmkr.com/F1a1b2c3"
  tour_key: string;    // Parsed tour key, e.g. "a1b2c3"
  lat: number;         // Decimal latitude
  lng: number;         // Decimal longitude
  height_m: number;    // Elevation in meters
  distance_km: number; // Cumulative route distance from start (km)
  thumbnail: string;   // Image preview URL
}

export interface TrailDetail {
  difficulty: 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard' | 'expert';
  activity_type: 'hiking' | 'trail-running' | 'mountain-biking' | 'walking' | 'off-road';
  total_distance_km: number;
  elevation_gain_m: number;
  elevation_loss_m: number;
  elevation_min_m: number;
  elevation_max_m: number;
  points: TrailPointDetail[];
}

export interface PostDetailResponse {
  statusCode: 200;
  data: {
    valid: true;
    messages: string;
    posts: {
      slug: string;
      post_type: 'trail' | 'tourmkr' | 'gvt' | 'villume' | 'panorama';
      location_name: string;
      description: string;
      thumbnail: string;
      panorama: string;

issues.display_title: Issue #582: Trail Post: New GET /posts/trails Endpoint for the Trail Menu
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-12 GET /posts/trails Endpoint for Trail Menu

Summary

Implemented the new feed endpoint GET /posts/trails to power the Trail Menu sidebar in the Panorra PWA, fulfilling Epic #578 and Issue #582.

Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Action/V1/Posts/ListTrails.go:
    • Implemented ListTrails(c *fiber.Ctx) handler.
    • Enforces user/viewer authorization and resolves content visibility (blocked posts & deactivated users).
    • Queries views_timeline_post filtered by category_id = 8, post_type = 'trail', and visibility = 'public'.
    • Supports standard pagination (page, limit default 10) via Functions.Pagination.
    • Attaches trail summary (difficulty, activity_type, total_distance_km, elevation_gain_m, points_count) per item.
    • Respects ec encrypted response header.
    • Added mockable QueryTrails, LoadTrailSummary, and ResolveContentVisibility variables for database-less testing.
  2. src/Controllers/V1/PostsControllers.go:
    • Added controller ListTrails(c *fiber.Ctx) delegating to Action handler.
  3. src/Routes/V1/PostsRoutes.go:
    • Registered GET /posts/trails under the posts route group.
  4. src/Action/V1/Posts/TrailPosts_test.go:
    • Unit tests covering route authorization, pagination, trail summary mapping, and ec encryption.

Frontend Integration Guide

Endpoint

GET /posts/trails

Headers

Header Value Required Description
Authorization Bearer <JWT_TOKEN> Optional (supports viewer role) User auth
ec "true" or "false" Optional Toggle AES-CBC response encryption

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
page integer No 1 Page number
limit integer No 10 Number of items per page

Response Model (TypeScript)

export interface TrailSummary {
  difficulty: 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard' | 'expert';
  activity_type: 'hiking' | 'trail-running' | 'mountain-biking' | 'walking' | 'off-road';
  total_distance_km: number;
  elevation_gain_m: number;
  points_count: number;
}

export interface TrailFeedItem {
  slug: string;
  category_id: 8;
  created_at: string;
  description: string;
  short_description: string;
  long_description: string;
  location_name: string;
  location_post: Record<string, any>;
  thumbnail: string;
  panorama_preview: string;
  post_type: 'trail';
  avatar: string;
  fullname: string;
  username: string;
  visibility: 'public';
  bookmark: boolean;
  folder: string | null;
  trail: TrailSummary;
}

export interface ListTrailsResponse {
  statusCode: 200;
  data: {
    valid: true;
    messages: string;
    posts: TrailFeedItem[];
    pagination: {
      total: number;
      page: number;
      limit: number;
      total_pages: number;
    };
  };
}

Example Usage

Epic: #578 (trail-post)
PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md, task BE-12
Estimate: 1 day

Problem

The PWA gets a new Trail menu in the sidebar. No feed endpoint lists trail posts: GET /search/post?category= only accepts categories 1 to 7 and carries no trail data.

Scope

  • New endpoint GET /posts/trails (the name is a proposal).
  • Returns posts with category_id = 8 (Trail) that are published, visibility = 'public' and not banned, newest first.
  • page and limit like the other feeds (Functions.Pagination).
  • Same safety filters as the other feeds: blocked posts, blocked and deactivated users, roles user and viewer.
  • Item shape follows the existing feed item, plus a trail summary:
{
  "trail": {
    "difficulty": "medium",
    "activity_type": "hiking",
    "total_distance_km": 12.8,
    "elevation_gain_m": 640,
    "points_count": 5
  }
}
  • Honour the ec header like the other GET feeds.
  • Route, controller, action and an api-collection entry.

Out of scope

  • Sorting or filtering by difficulty, activity or distance.

Depends on

BE-02.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Only public, published trail posts are listed.
  • Drafts, unlisted and private trail posts are not listed.
  • Each item carries the trail summary.
